levels.surface: أبو أحمد هاني بن محمد بن محمود العبدي

notes: Rule 11: the Imam Musa ibn Ja'far speaks and acts in a narrated encounter with al-Rashid («دخل ... على الرشيد ... فقال موسى»); whether he is a link or only in the scene is not settled, so he is not added
«بإسناده» is a back reference; no previous report supplies it, so it stays as written
«- رفعه -» and «رَضِىَ اللهُ عَنْهُ» and «عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ» are left out
